_comment: RAKSHAK stream-source registrations. There is no cameras table in this schema, so fixed cameras are registered here and shared by backend/stream_source.py and scripts/stream_camera.py. Kinds: mjpeg (http(s) URL of an MJPEG stream), rtsp (RTSP URL), usb (device index), video (file path). Frames are memory-only; nothing here is persisted.
